review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — Decisions section lists 1-7 with the date 2026-11-23, and the two old rows are struck through with pointers to the new decisions.
- A2: met — The Cloud Run section replaces the alternative, with local docker build and run, the build arg, the gcloud command and a person-only note. Whether the Dockerfile actually has the build arg is not shown in this diff.
- A3: met — README covers npm run dev, the docker build and run steps, the localhost:8080 URL and Cloud Run as the target, and says Firebase Hosting is no longer a target.
- A4: met — The diff touches only README.md and docs/PLAN.md.

<details><summary>3 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Demo-account steps now sit under the container heading but point at port 3000 `README.md:30` — Move the demo-account paragraph and list under '### Run locally', or add a short '### Sign in' heading after both run sections.
- Unexplained 'D6' reference and unverified claims about the Dockerfile and CI `docs/PLAN.md:263` — Link or define D6 (or drop the sentence), and confirm the Dockerfile ARG and workflow claims before merging.
- Other Firebase-as-backend text left unmarked `docs/PLAN.md` — Reword the row to 'backend rules handle authorization' or add a superseded note.

</details>

_claude-sonnet-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: Demo-account steps now sit under the container heading but point at port 3000
suggestions.detail: The new '### Run in a container' section was inserted before the 'Open http://localhost:3000/cloud/ and sign in with a demo account' paragraph. That paragraph and the demo-account list now read as part of the container section, while their URL belongs to the npm run dev flow.
suggestions.repro: Read README.md Quick start top to bottom: the container section ends with 'open localhost:8080', and the next paragraph says to open localhost:3000.
suggestions.fix: Move the demo-account paragraph and list under '### Run locally', or add a short '### Sign in' heading after both run sections.

suggestions.title: Unexplained 'D6' reference and unverified claims about the Dockerfile and CI
suggestions.detail: 'The region waits on D6' refers to something not defined in this diff. The text also states that the Dockerfile's NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND build arg defaults to local, and that no workflow deploys. Neither the Dockerfile nor the workflows are in this change, so the docs can't be checked against them here.
suggestions.repro: Search docs/PLAN.md for 'D6' and confirm the Dockerfile has ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND=local.
suggestions.fix: Link or define D6 (or drop the sentence), and confirm the Dockerfile ARG and workflow claims before merging.

suggestions.title: Other Firebase-as-backend text left unmarked
suggestions.detail: The 'Static export with the browser talking to the backend directly' row still says 'Firebase rules handle authorization', and Phase 4b stays active-looking. The Phase 4 banner covers it, but the row itself disagrees with decision 1.
suggestions.repro: Read the 'Decisions already made' table after the two superseded rows.
suggestions.fix: Reword the row to 'backend rules handle authorization' or add a superseded note.
